sloka: ततो वाजिरथान् युक्त्वा दिव्यान् हेमपरिष्कृतान् ।अध्यारोहत् प्रयाणार्थी बहून् बहुविधो जन: ॥ २.९२.३२॥
transliteration: tato vājirathān yuktvā divyān hemapariṣkṛtān ।adhyārohat prayāṇārthī bahūn bahuvidho jana: ॥ 2.92.32॥

translations.english: Different groups of people intending to depart harnessed excellent horsechariots decorated with gold.
